k:符.mnemonic: A slip of bamboo (竹) split down the middle. Attach (付) your half to mine, and if the edges fit, you are who you say you are. Token (sign, mark, tally).

k:寧.mnemonic: Under my own roof (宀), the fishing net (罒) hung up, one dish (皿) of supper, the day complete (了) and my heart (心) at peace. I would choose this over any feast. Rather (preferably, peaceful, quiet).
k:寧.hint: A quiet supper beats a feast.

k:袖.mnemonic: A cloak (衤) worn in the rice field (田) needs its arms rolled up, or the ends trail in the mud. Sleeve (wing, extension, give cold shoulder).
k:袖.hint: Roll them up in the paddy.

k:彫.mnemonic: All around the circumference (周) of the bowl the knife cuts fine lines like whiskers (彡), one shaving at a time. Carve (engrave, chisel).
k:彫.hint: Fine lines cut round a bowl.

k:悔.mnemonic: Every (毎) night the same person (人) lies awake with a thudding heartbeat (忄), wishing the thing undone. Repent (regret).
k:悔.hint: Awake each night wishing it undone.

k:諭.mnemonic: For a month (月) he let it pass. Now (今) he will say (言) it, in words as sharp as a knife (刂): you know better than this. Rebuke (admonish, charge, warn).
k:諭.hint: Sharp words after weeks of patience.

k:峡.mnemonic: The mountain (山) is split in two, and the husband (夫) stands at the bottom of the narrow cleft, looking up at a thin strip of sky. Gorge (ravine).
k:峡.hint: A strip of sky far above.

k:享.mnemonic: The lid is off the pot, and a child (子) stands over it with his mouth (口) full of what was inside, grinning from ear to ear. Enjoy (receive, undergo, take).

k:簿.mnemonic: Dr. (博) writes each patient's name on slips of bamboo (竹), ink flowing like a tsunami (氵), and binds them into one long book. Register (record book).

k:臭.mnemonic: Point at your self (自) and you point at your nose. A big (大) smell is hitting it right now: somebody has stepped in something. Stinking (ill-smelling, suspicious looking, odor).

k:鋭.mnemonic: Elder brother (兄) gets the gold (金) spear with the needle tip, because only he can be trusted not to prick anyone with it. Pointed (sharpness, edge, weapon).

k:尼.mnemonic: She lives under the temple flag (尸) and owns one bowl and one spoon (匕), nothing more, and wants nothing more. Nun.
k:尼.hint: One bowl, one spoon, a temple.

k:据.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) lower the heavy stove into the spot where it will reside (居) for good, and wedge it until it sits level. Set (lay a foundation, install, equip).

k:狩.mnemonic: To protect (守) the fields from wild boar, the villagers go out at first light with a hound (犭) running ahead on the scent. Hunt (raid, gather).
k:狩.hint: Out at first light after boar.

k:裸.mnemonic: His cloak (衤) hangs on a tree (木) while he bathes in the flooded rice field (田), wearing nothing at all. Naked (nude, uncovered, partially clothed).
k:裸.hint: Clothes on a branch, bather below.

k:焦.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) left too long over the flames (灬) comes out black on the outside, and the cook runs back in a panic, too late. Char (hurry, impatient, irritate).

k:稚.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) chick pecks at grain (禾) too big for its beak. It is still small, downy and not ready for the world. Immature (young).

k:酷.mnemonic: The revelation (告) at the feast: the wine jar (酉) held vinegar all along, and the host laughs as his thirsty guests wince. Cruel (severe, atrocious, unjust).
k:酷.hint: The host laughs at wincing guests.

k:奮.mnemonic: A big (大) turkey (隹) bursts up out of the rice field (田), wings beating and feathers puffed, ready to take on anyone. Stirred up (be invigorated, flourish).

k:妃.mnemonic: A woman (女) with a cobra (已) rearing on her crown, like the rulers of ancient Egypt. Everyone in the hall bows to her. Queen (princess).
k:妃.hint: A serpent rearing on her crown.

k:壇.mnemonic: Walk three times (回) around the hedge (垣) and you find a raised platform of earth in the middle, where the speaker stands to be seen. Stage (podium, rostrum, terrace).
k:壇.hint: A raised platform inside the greenery.

k:惨.mnemonic: He was made to participate (参) in the race with a pounding heartbeat (忄) and a twisted ankle, and limped in last through the rain. Wretched (disaster, cruelty, harsh).
k:惨.hint: Limping in last in the rain.

k:孔.mnemonic: A child (子) pokes a fishhook (乙) into the river bank and wiggles it about, leaving a small round hole. Cavity (hole, slit, very).
k:孔.hint: A hook wiggled into the bank.

k:弦.mnemonic: A bow (弓) gives off a mysterious (玄) hum when the dark cord stretched across it is plucked. Bowstring (chord, hypotenuse).

k:芽.mnemonic: Long before the flowers (艹), a tiny green tusk (牙) pushes its point up through the soil. Bud (sprout, spear, germ).
k:芽.hint: A green point through the soil.

k:殴.mnemonic: A cartoon thug swings a weapon (殳) at everyone in the ward (区), stars and bumps flying, until the constable carries him off. Assault (hit, beat, thrash).
k:殴.hint: Stars and bumps all over town.

k:拉.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) drag a schoolboy by the collar to stand (立) before the class and recite his verbs in the language of old Rome. Latin (kidnap, crush).
k:拉.hint: Dragged up to recite Roman verbs.

k:誓.mnemonic: With fingers (扌) resting on the axe (斤), you say (言) the words aloud: may this turn on me if I ever break my promise. Vow (swear, pledge).
k:誓.hint: A promise spoken over a blade.

k:崇.mnemonic: A mountain (山) so grand that it has become a religion (宗). Pilgrims gaze up at its snowy top with shining eyes. Adore (respect, revere, worship).
k:崇.hint: Pilgrims gazing up at a peak.

k:譜.mnemonic: The judges evaluate (評) the choir all day (日), following every note on the sheets spread out in front of them. Musical score (music, note, staff).
